description: This file defines a custom matcher function 'toHaveURLWithPredicate' for Playwright testing, which waits for a page URL to match a predicate, and a helper function 'toHaveURLMessage' for formatting matcher messages.

methods.name: toHaveURLWithPredicate
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a page URL to satisfy a predicate, returning a MatcherResult indicating success or failure.

methods.name: toHaveURLMessage
methods.description: Generates a formatted message string for the matcher result, indicating expected and received URL states.
